reason: A Telegram Bot API bridge that relays authorized private-chat text messages to per-chat agent sessions and sends formatted responses back through Telegram using long polling.

summaries.zh: 通过 Telegram Bot API 长轮询将获授权的私聊文本消息接入智能体会话，并把智能体回复格式化后发送回 Telegram。
summaries.en: Bridges authorized private-chat text messages to per-chat agent sessions through the Telegram Bot API and sends formatted agent responses back to Telegram.

capabilities: Connects to the Telegram Bot API using a bot token
Long-polls and receives authorized text messages from Telegram chats
Creates or reuses per-chat agent sessions and forwards user messages
Sends agent responses back to Telegram chats with HTML formatting and message splitting
